info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Risk Model Refinement API
info.description: The Market Risk Model Refinement API enables financial institutions to enhance their market risk models by updating parameters and configurations. Users can modify specific aspects of existing models to better reflect market conditions and risk exposures. This API is particularly useful for risk analysts and data scientists who need to adjust model accuracy routinely. Streamlining these updates ensures that organizations maintain robust risk management practices against market volatility.

patch.summary: Update a specific market risk model.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific market risk model identified by its unique reference RES-100045. Provide the necessary information in the request body to modify the model attributes accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the market risk model identified by RES-100045. It contains the fields that can be modified for the specified model. Please ensure that all necessary parameters are included in the body to guarantee a successful update.
